measure.measure_definition: Time to event: duration in days from randomization to first clinic-based or telehealth appointment with a rheumatologist; Participants; Appointment records used to calculate median (IQR) duration in days; first clinic-based or telehealth appointment with a rheumatologist; the source notes this may differ conceptually from referral-to-appointment duration.; Time origin: randomization. Event: first clinic-based or telehealth appointment with a rheumatologist. Reported as median (IQR) days; no censoring reported. A shorter duration indicates earlier access.

measure.measure_definition: Measured value: pain intensity in the past 7 days on a 0–10 Numeric Rating Scale; Participants; Self-reported questionnaire at baseline and follow-up; median (IQR) summarized at each time point. Table 3 reports baseline and 3-month data; later time points are outside this task scope.; 0–10 Numeric Rating Scale; 0 = no pain, 10 = worst pain imaginable. Higher scores indicate greater pain intensity.

population.intervention: Rapid Stratified Telehealth or usual clinic-based care
population.intervention_regimen: Randomized 2:1 to Rapid Stratified Telehealth or usual care; planned follow-up to 6 months.
population.population_definition: All randomized participants irrespective of treatment allocation; Adults aged 18 years or older with low back pain (non-specific low back pain or radicular low back pain/sciatica of any duration); new referral to the Back Clinic from primary care (not previously on the waiting list); willing to participate for up to 6 months and provide follow-up data at 6 weeks, 3 months and 6 months. Exclusions: suspected serious underlying pathology (e.g. cancer, fracture, infection, inflammatory arthritis, cauda equina syndrome) or referral strongly suggestive of concerning neurological features (e.g. progressive radiculopathy).
population.population_time_frame: Recruitment July 2021 to March 2024; follow-up assessments at 6 weeks, 3 months and 6 months.

population.intervention: Rapid Stratified Telehealth: mode and type of care matched to Keele STarT MSK risk (low, medium, high) and potential radiculopathy; rheumatologist initial call; low risk advice, walking, paracetamol if required and written education; medium/high risk physiotherapist-led telehealth with PhysiTrack app; high risk online pain education; potential radiculopathy clinic-based rheumatologist and physiotherapy care.
population.intervention_regimen: Not reported (paracetamol dose not specified); Initial rheumatologist call; low risk: advice only with callback if no improvement over 6 weeks; medium/high risk: physiotherapist-led telehealth (maximum 12 sessions over 6 months); high risk: online pain education; potential radiculopathy: clinic-based rheumatologist (maximum 4 appointments over 6 months) and clinic-based physiotherapy (maximum 12 over 6 months).
